data.name: AdoptAnotherVersion
data.value: The entry has a patch from another version of this library, which only that version can remove.

data.name: AdoptEntryMismatch
data.value: The page claims a different entry, so nothing is assumed about it.

data.name: AdoptForeignPatch
data.value: The entry is redirected by something other than this library, so it's left alone.

data.name: AdoptNoCaptures
data.value: The patch at {0} captures nothing, so there's no call to read.

data.name: AdoptNotRedirected
data.value: The entry isn't redirected.

data.name: AdoptStolenLengthOutOfRange
data.value: The page records {0} displaced bytes, which isn't a length this library writes, so it's left alone.

data.name: AdoptUnexpectedPatchLength
data.value: The page records a {0}-byte patch, and this library only writes a 5-byte jump, so it's left alone.

data.name: AdoptUnknownLayout
data.value: The patch at {0} was adopted, and its layout isn't known, so its calls can't be read.

data.name: AdoptUnreadableEntry
data.value: The code at {0} couldn't be read, so no patch there can be adopted.

data.name: BatchNotSuspended
data.value: The target's threads could not be suspended for the batch, so each write suspends them itself. {0}

data.name: CaptureFloatNotAnAddress
data.value: A floating point value can't be read through, because it isn't an address.

data.name: CaptureFloatWidth
data.value: A floating point value is 4 or 8 bytes wide, not {0}.

data.name: CaptureNoRegisters
data.value: A 32-bit target passes every argument on the stack, so there's no register to capture.

data.name: CaptureOutsidePayload
data.value: A capture of {0} bytes at 0x{1} falls outside the record's payload.

data.name: CaptureOverlappingCaptures
data.value: The captures at 0x{0} and 0x{1} overlap, so 1 would be read as the other.

data.name: CaptureRegisterIndexOutOfRange
data.value: Argument {0} isn't in a register. Only the first 4 are.

data.name: CaptureStackIndexOutOfRange
data.value: Stack slot {0} can't take an argument. Slots count from 0, the first one above the return address.

data.name: CaptureUnknownCaptureSource
data.value: A stub can't capture from {0}.

data.name: CaptureUnstorableWidth
data.value: A capture of {0} bytes isn't a width 1 store covers. A store covers 1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes.

data.name: CaptureWidthBeyondPointer
data.value: A capture of {0} bytes is wider than the {1} bytes a store on this target moves.

data.name: ChainedScanNeedsStep
data.value: A chained scan needs at least 1 step.

data.name: DataDirectoryOutOfRange
data.value: A data directory has 16 entries.

data.name: HostSizedType

data.name: InstallPoolFull

data.name: InstallPoolOutOfReach

data.name: InstallThreadInside
data.value: A thread stands inside the instructions at {0}. It's left alone and the next attempt checks again.

data.name: InstallThreadsNotSuspended
data.value: Not every thread of the target could be suspended and read, so nothing is claimed about {0}.
